svg.text: Beads in the membrane band = residues the model assigns to a membrane span (2-column helix packing is illustrative). Charge colours are approximate side-chain classes; they are context, not a topology predictor.
Dashed “…” bead: residues 49–367 omitted in this view (319 aa) — every residue is shown in the full sequence map (B).
